# namespace_tenant_group (Data Source)

Fetches details of an existing Namespace Cloud IAM tenant group by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_tenant_group" "prod" {
  name = "production-workspaces"
}

output "enrolled_tenants" {
  value = data.namespace_tenant_group.prod.enrolled_tenant_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tenant group to query.

### Read-Only

- `enrolled_tenant_ids` (List of String) List of tenant IDs enrolled in this tenant group.
- `id` (String) Identifier matching the tenant group name.
- `policies` (Attributes List) List of active policies attached to the tenant group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))
- `versions` (Attributes List) Historical policy versions configured for this tenant group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `policy` (String) Fully qualified policy identifier type.
- `value` (String) Policy configuration value.


<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `policy` (String) Policy identifier type.
- `value` (String) Policy configuration value.
